purpose: Repository-side contract for reading local Parquet layers from corpus-legislation-nz and corpus-nz-hansard, then promoting selected normalized JSON/JSONL corpus artifacts into rulespec-nz.

sources.name: Corpus Legislation NZ local Parquet export
sources.role: Local columnar mirror of official NZ legislation provision text for source locator, coverage, and RuleSpec provenance joins.

sources.name: Corpus NZ Hansard local Parquet export
sources.role: Local columnar Hansard text for parliamentary context, explanatory evidence, and later non-authoritative semantic review.

authority_boundaries: Use corpus-legislation-nz only when its records retain official NZ Legislation citation paths and source metadata.
Use corpus-nz-hansard as parliamentary context only; do not cite Hansard as executable RuleSpec law authority.
Keep raw Parquet exports local and promote only small, deliberate normalized JSON or JSONL artifacts.
deferred_work: Add tiny synthetic Parquet or Arrow fixtures for reader smoke tests.
Validate table contracts against real local corpus-legislation-nz and corpus-nz-hansard exports.
Add semantic source-spec auditing over promoted normalized records.
